examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the site places it: six customer quotes in a framed carousel, each with its client mark and signature, and one call to action under the tabs. A band with no items renders nothing at all.

examples.name: Still
examples.summary: `autoplay` off holds one quote, and `v-model` (the selected index) opens the band on the second client. Use it when the page must not move or must lead with a given customer.
